character: A young ratfolk woman, sleek brown fur, whiskers trimmed neat, a notch in one ear, bright black eyes. Thin. An eager, hungry half-smile.
wardrobe: A captain's coat two sizes too big, cuffs rolled twice, patched canvas beneath, a ring of keys at her belt.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing with her chin up, one hand on the keys.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Standing at the end of a rope gangway reaching toward a dark airship with black sails, hanging on lines beneath a floating rock.
